content: Crandon’s smile faltered a little as his eyes moved back and forth, she could see his mind forming words from pieces of lessons over the past year, then with a nod he spoke .  “We are able to identify with a creature, something that mirror’s our own values and strengths, that animal is amplified and made real through the spell of the  SenPai , giving the Warden a friend in combat and a scout in tracking , ” he  offered,  and his smile grew wider, again he had done  well,  and Corliss conceded the young man had learned well.  “Okay then, let’s see how you do , ” ***   Crandon ’s face brightened ,  push ing up the jacket  sleeve,  he deftly ran   his fingers once more over crystal runes  encased in the worn leather bracer .  Touching the last  crystal  he paused and ran a finger across a deep gash in the old leather.  “Every wound tells a story, respect and learn from those who have come before you” The  gravely  voice of the old Warden echoed in his head.  The day he had become a Warden, the day he had  received  the tools he now wore.  It was called  the ceremony of change,  the time  where an old  warden   retired   and a new one  took   their place .  Crandon had looked on as the old man gently laid out the Sen Pai, the pistol and a worn pair of boots, the two men’s eyes meeting for  a brief moment .  He remembered those watery blue eyes, so full of sadness and regret and as the old man finished organizing the small pile, he paused for a moment to run his gnarled fingers over the very same scar in the leather that he did now and in a tone low enough for only Crandon to hear he had spoken those words.  Then with an almost imperceptible nod towards the small pile he gave his silent permission for Crandon to take them.  He remembered feeling sadness for the old Warden tempering the excitement of his own becoming as he stood and  watched  the  old man, no longer a Warden, step over to take his place in the circle of onlookers.  Joining those watching as Crandon stepped forward, reverently gathering the items and carefully putting them on, thus taking his place as a Warden of the keep .   *** Corliss watched as the runes  lit  in sequence as  closing  his eyes his  Crandond’s   fingers  danced  over the bracer as  a ball of blue  energy formed next to him .   Blinking  into existence  forming  into  the shape  a large horned owl.  Taking flight, the  spectral animal   began to circle the two of them , rising further and further above the ground.   Corliss watched impressed at the young man’s skill in calling forth his spirit bond.  She looked into his now white eyes as they opened ,  she knew he was looking through the eyes of the owl, seeing what it saw high above the ground .  With a nod of approval , she spoke  quietly   “ Now send him out and tell me what’s around  us”.  With an almost instantaneous reaction the creature lifted further into the air, floating over the currents as it made its way out towards the distant woods.   *** Crandon heard the words as if from a long distance away, his senses now one with the creature above, he could feel the wind across his face and arms, could see himself and Corliss far below, despite the distance he could even make out the buttons on his own coat.  He had been told that  sing the vision of the spirit bond left the warden vulnerable to attack  but had truly not understood what that meant until now. Tearing himself away from the scene below, he focused out beyond the plains and forest, looking for landmarks and activity in the distance .
